function.name: list_cookie_definitions
function.description: Unavailable: this tool is not implemented and must not be called. List read-only cookie definitions configured in Cookie Management with optional category and keyword filters.

category.description: Optional cookie category filter, such as necessary, preference, statistics, or marketing.

keyword.description: Optional keyword for cookie name, domain, provider, or purpose search.

includeJsDetectedCookies.description: Whether to include cookies discovered from JavaScript analysis. Default: false
